subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw add synchronous result-return semantics to `POST /hooks/agent`, and if so should it be `waitForResult` on the existing endpoint, a separate sync endpoint, or a result-fetch flow?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the endpoint is authenticated external ingress and the proposed response reflects agent output, so the permanent API and security boundary require maintainer intent before implementation should land.

options.title: Adopt guarded wait mode
options.body: Land an opt-in existing-endpoint mode after adding explicit result limits, timeout/concurrency behavior, replay handling, redaction/error rules, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Use separate sync/result endpoint
options.body: Keep async `/hooks/agent` unchanged and introduce a clearer endpoint or result-fetch contract with its own security model.

options.title: Decline core API change
options.body: Document `/hooks/agent` plus `sessions_history` as the supported pattern and leave synchronous callback behavior to downstream integrations for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded wait mode
recommendation.body: Land an opt-in existing-endpoint mode after adding explicit result limits, timeout/concurrency behavior, replay handling, redaction/error rules, docs, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the gateway hook/session-key boundary and was explicitly tagged for API-shape review in the linked discussion.
